class.name: VolumetricFog
class.brief_description: Real-time OpenGL 4.3 compute-raymarched volumetric fog supporting depth-texture SpotLights and DirectionalLights, screen-space OmniLights, LocalFogVolumes, and BakedFogVolumes.
class.description: [VolumetricFog] renders volumetric scattering and absorption using raw OpenGL 4.3 depth rasterization and compute shaders, avoiding 3D spatial shader conflicts. [DirectionalLight]s and [SpotLight]s use pooled raw OpenGL depth-array passes with PCF for shadowed god rays, while [OmniLight]s are evaluated in screen space with optional screen-space depth occlusion.

method.name: get_fog_texture
method.description: Returns the generated RGBA16F premultiplied-alpha volumetric fog [Texture]. RGB holds tonemapped premultiplied inscatter and A holds opacity ([code]1.0 - transmittance[/code]).

members.member: Automatically composites the volumetric fog onto the active viewport on a background 2D canvas layer after all 3D spatial shaders and before 2D UI. Disable if manually sampling [method get_fog_texture].
Number of edge-aware bilateral spatial denoising passes executed in linear HDR before tonemapping.
